title: Setup settings pages keep the manifest from their first load after a save, so the live-transport banner on Setup → Email shows the pre-save statement until the page is reloaded
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named landing point and a reach**. This is the console half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#25335, handed over by the services seat. The server half, objectstack-ai/objectstack#25448, is in the merge queue. Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post #5560, project run by the Sales account, `session_01WJozybDmRH8z2c5SD7vJkj`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and labels are triage's.

**Who acts:** the `domain:ui` seat 1, by a sub-agent, after triage grades it.

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** Setup → Email, viewed by an administrator. The same holds for every settings namespace whose manifest the server computes per read.
- **What the server does:** after objectstack#25448, `GET /api/settings/:namespace` asks a live-status provider on every read. It puts the provider's answer first in `manifest.specifiers`, as an `info_banner` with id `live_status`. For `mail`, the banner reads "No mail leaves this machine" while the log transport is in use, and "Mail is delivered through SMTP (host:port)" once a real transport is configured.
- **What the console does now:** `SettingsView`'s `onSave` merges only the PUT response's `values` into the page (`setPayload({ ...payload, values: { ...values, ...res.values } })`). The manifest from the first GET is kept and never read again. `onAction` re-reads nothing either.
- **Effect:** an administrator saves SMTP settings and the banner still says no mail leaves the machine. The page tells the truth only after a reload.
- **Evidence:** I read the code on objectui `origin/main` `ff77cfc22`. The services seat read the published 18.0.0 tarball and saw the same thing. It has not been checked in a running console.

`Seam: runtime:service-settings GET /api/settings/:namespace manifest.specifiers[0] (info_banner id live_status) → renderer:@object-ui/console SettingsView save handler (merges PUT values only; manifest never re-read)`

## Landing (read on objectui `origin/main` `ff77cfc22`)

- **Where:** `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsView.tsx`, in the `onSave` success branch and in `onAction`.
- **The read already exists:** the load effect keyed on `namespace` calls `getSettingsNamespace` (`apps/console/src/pages/settings/api.ts`) and sets the payload. After a successful save, call that same read and take its whole payload, manifest included. After a successful action, do the same; leave the draft as it is, because an action does not save it.
- **Keep:** the draft, field-error and crypto-refusal resets on save stay as they are.
- **Keep:** if the re-read fails, keep today's merged values. The save itself succeeded, so the page must not turn into an error.
- **Keep:** do not flip `loading`. The form must not flash its placeholder on a save.
- **Banner rendering:** `SettingsField` already draws an `info_banner` from the payload it is handed. Its `labels.bannerText(spec.id, …)` lookup finds no pack key for `live_status`, so the server's text is shown.

## Done when

- On Setup → Email, after saving a change, the `live_status` banner shows what the next GET returns, without a reload.
- The same holds after a successful action.
- A save whose re-read fails still shows the saved values and the success toast.
- An unsaved draft survives an action.
- A console pin covers this with a fake API whose second GET returns a different banner, plus a control that the first load is unchanged.

**Size:** S (one file plus its test and a changeset; about 15 non-test lines).

## Dedupe

Method: objectui issue search (repo-scoped, any state) on `SettingsView refetch` in title and body, and on `25335`, at 2026-10-23T14:50Z. `SettingsView refetch` returned 4 hits, all closed and about other surfaces: #10982 (ObjectView bus re-read), #5567 (`showRefresh` on `object-view`), #4568 (`ObjectView.handleRefresh`) and #4564 (`DataSource.deleteView` return). `25335` returned 0 hits. **New.**
